ledger.claim: The baseline charge fails on dwell, and it fails on the driver's own device. His trace fixes his longest continuous stay inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at 240 seconds, running 06:54:40 to 06:58:40 as a single unbroken sequence of 25 qualifying fixes, against a free waiting period in force of 300 seconds read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (the resolution rule reads platform_policy before the 180-second default, and the derived STANDARD minimum_dwell_sec is 300 on the same basis). POL-NS-01(c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least that period, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the arrival tap, so limb (c) is not carried and no cancellation fee was chargeable.

POL-NS-06 decides the shortfall directly and by arithmetic: the effective in-geofence dwell is 240 seconds, the minimum in force is 300 seconds, and the shortfall is 60 seconds. On that basis the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, with no driver compensation payable — and the clause applies whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to any message.

Limb (d) fails on the same clock. The trip was terminated by the driver under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 06:58:40, which is 240 seconds after the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:54:40 — before the required dwell had elapsed. Limb (d) requires termination at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, so the driver cannot make out his fourth condition either.

The rider's account that 'he didn't wait five minutes' is corroborated by the platform's own timestamps rather than contradicted by them: accepted 06:50:30, first qualifying in-geofence fix 06:54:40, cancelled 06:58:40 — a four-minute hold against the five-minute free waiting period the trip record carries. On this record her statement and the trace agree.

The 240 seconds cannot be padded into 300 on any reading. POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road and window, and there is no second interval to sum in any event — the trace shows a single in-geofence run with no excursion. The advisory artifact is MISSING, and the policy says a MISSING traffic_advisory makes limb (i) unavailable rather than exonerating anyone; its absence is itself citable.

ledger.claim: No payout is owed to the driver. POL-NS-07 pays the 80 percent compensation only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Here limbs (c) and (d) fail and POL-NS-06 applies, so the SGD 3.20 the money block computes is not payable on this trip.

The money should be left exactly where it is. The ledger shows the $4.00 cancellation fee charged on 2026-08-22 and then refunded in full (refund_issued_sgd $4.00, payment_status REFUNDED). The driver filed asking for that charge to be put back, and his claim fails on the dwell arithmetic, so the disposition is NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03: the filing party's claim is not supported, the present state stands, and the rider does not carry the disputed $4.00.

There is no reason to hold this money for a human reviewer instead of closing it. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c) does not fire, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so limb (d) does not fire on the rider side. The deciding fact — the dwell — is carried by two COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap is the maximum of their weights, not the minimum, and the 0.70 floor is not approached.

The anti-farming branch does not trip either, so the fee need not be frozen. For the POL-NS-07 check, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the required absolute count of 4, and set against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 it is a rate far under 0.08; the clause requires both limbs and neither is met. The case can be decided on the record, leaving the rider's refund standing.

I disclose rather than conceal the state of the chat evidence: EV-CHAT-00408 is impaired at weight 0.85, carrying issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE because neither entry shows a read receipt, and I do not present it as clean. Taken at face value it does not assist the driver — it holds a system 'driver has arrived' notice and one driver message at 06:55:00, with no rider reply — and nothing in it extends the 240-second dwell the trace records or otherwise enlarges the waiting clock.

The driver's arrival is established on the trace itself: the derived arrival block places the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:54:40, records 25 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class, and the closest approach recorded anywhere in the trace is 5.4 m from the pickup pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are satisfied on the driver's own COMPLETE, weight-1.0 device telemetry - this is not a driver who never reached the pickup.

The termination side of the record favours the driver's account: the trip is recorded CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER at 06:58:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, and there is no boarding event anywhere on the record (started_at and ended_at are null). The reason-code and no-boarding elements of limb (d) are therefore met, and the only element of this episode the driver loses on is the length of his dwell.

The arrival marker is true and not false: the arrived event at 06:54:40 is also the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so the marker was not pressed from more than 300 m out and not at 15 km/h or more. POL-NS-05 is not engaged on this trip and no false-arrival event should be recorded against this driver in the ruling's referrals.

The rider's own telemetry contradicts his account that he came down and the car was gone: his 27 fixes run from 06:54:40 to 06:58:34 at a flat 0.0 km/h and lie between 496.9 m and 503.8 m from the pickup pin, so his qualifying-fix count inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius is 0. POL-NS-04 limb (c) is therefore affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, the clause cannot exonerate the rider, and the dispute returns to POL-NS-01.

The rider never once wrote to the driver during the waiting window: the chat log carries two entries only - the system's 'Your driver has arrived' at 06:54:41 and the driver's own 'here at blk 621' at 06:55:00 - so POL-NS-04 limb (a) fails as well, and the rider's complaint that he was let down is unsupported by his own conduct. Disclosure: EV-CHAT-00408 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 on issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE (both messages delivered, read_at null); that impairment bears only on whether the messages were read, not on whether the rider sent any, so the point survives the discount.

Concession on the one element the record does not give the driver: the derived arrival block measures his continuous in-geofence dwell at 240 seconds (25 fixes, 06:54:40 to 06:58:40), while this trip's platform_policy_in_force carries free_wait_sec of 300 seconds - a shortfall of 60 seconds - so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable whether or not the rider was present, and no driver compensation is payable. I do not contest that arithmetic and I do not ask the Judge to read the period in force as anything other than the 300 seconds this record carries. What the record equally does not support is any finding that the driver was absent or that the rider was at the pin; the driver's difficulty is the clock, not the facts.

If the Judge does find the dwell element satisfied, the emitted ruling must be DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd SGD 3.20 and not NO_ACTION: POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee in force - SGD 3.20, which is the figure the fare breakdown's own driver_compensation field carries - and POL-GEN-03 requires the ruling value to name the outcome the case produces, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd on that one ruling.

Nothing on either profile supports withholding the driver's money or escalating this case: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 120, so the count is not 4 or more and the rate is 0.0083, well under 0.08, and POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch is not tripped; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so no POL-NS-09(c) or (d) trigger exists. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags counters are not the trailing-window fields these clauses read and may not be substituted for them.

ruling.explanation:
Summary: the driver's arrival is confirmed on the record, but his wait was 60 seconds short of the free waiting period in force, so the $4.00 no-show fee was not chargeable. Because the fee has already been refunded, his request to have it reinstated is not supported and nothing further moves.

ARRIVAL — accepted. EV-GPS-00408 (weight 1.00) puts the first fix inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at 06:54:40, exactly the timestamp of the 'arrived' tap, and holds 25 qualifying fixes inside the radius. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are met. Because the marker coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the marker is not false, and no false-arrival referral is recorded against the driver on that ground.

DWELL — decisive, and both sides agree on the arithmetic. EV-TRIP-00408 (weight 1.00) carries a free waiting period of 300 seconds (platform_policy.free_wait_sec); EV-GPS-00408 measures a single continuous in-geofence stay of 240 seconds, from 06:54:40 to the cancellation at 06:58:40 — a 60-second shortfall. POL-NS-01(c) requires the full 300 seconds measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap, and limb (d) requires termination at or after that dwell elapsed; both fail. POL-NS-06 therefore applies: the fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not she was present or replied. No accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is possible — the trace shows run_count 1 with no second interval, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00408-01 is MISSING at weight 0.00, so limb (i) is unavailable rather than exculpatory.

DRIVER'S CLAIMS. His arrival claims (POL-NS-01(a)–(b), POL-NS-05) are accepted. His concession that the dwell was 240 seconds against 300 is accepted and is decisive. His conditional claim that a satisfied dwell would yield DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 3.20 (80% of the SGD 4.00 fee, the figure in the money block) is not reached: POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-01, so no compensation issues. His claims that the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1, below the required 4, against 120 completed trips in 30 days, a rate of 0.008 against the 0.08 threshold) and that no POL-NS-09 trigger fires are accepted; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counters are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used as a ground.

RIDER'S CLAIMS. Her account that the driver did not wait five minutes is corroborated by the timestamps and accepted; her claims that the fee is not chargeable, that no payout is owed, and that the disposition is NO_ACTION are accepted. Her own telemetry (27 fixes, 0.0 km/h, 496.9–503.8 m from the pin, 0 qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius) means POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her — but that changes nothing, because POL-NS-06 refunds the fee regardless of rider presence.

ESCALATION AND REFERRALS — none. Confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the trace is unimpaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d) (zero gaps, uniform 10-second cadence, arrival event matching the first fix to the second, and the SGD 4.00 fare line reconciling with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd); both counterparty-dispute counters are 0; the anti-farming check is not tripped. The rider's account that she came down is contradicted by her own track, but that is a statement against one unimpaired artifact, not two admissible artifacts in direct conflict under POL-NS-09(b), and in any event POL-NS-06 decides the fee whether or not she was present. No clause produces a referral, so the list is empty.

EVIDENCE WEIGHTS. The deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-00408 and EV-TRIP-00408, both weight 1.00 and both unimpaired under POL-NS-08, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.00 and confidence is 0.95. EV-CHAT-00408 is impaired at weight 0.85 for UNREAD_MESSAGE (both entries delivered, no read receipt); it carries no deciding fact and only discounts confidence under POL-GEN-02.

DISPOSITION. NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03. The driver filed to have the charge reinstated; that claim is not supported by the evidence, the present state stands, and the $4.00 already refunded (refund_issued_sgd 4.00, payment_status REFUNDED) stays refunded. No refund and no compensation is ordered: amount_sgd null, driver_compensation_sgd null. The monetary effect is SGD 0.00, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so nothing is held for release. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
